record.d: Mechanical watch carrying the legally protected 'Glashütte' designation, which since 2022 requires at least 50% of the value chain, including movement making, casing and final inspection, in Glashütte.

items.why: Protected designation of origin for a manufactured product, which the rubric keeps here with its producer list; no function kind covers an origin, so a kind (alternatively a Glashütte regional division in the brand register).
Already present: 'Vienna regulator' is an archetype under Wall regulator (and an alias of the kind) in rebuild/out/A5.json; the rubric's exists=false was wrong.

record.d: Mechanical wristwatch from the Soviet state watch industry, which began with the First Moscow Watch Factory in 1930 and made brands such as Pobeda (from 1947), Sturmanskie and Poljot (from 1964).

items.why: Collected and sold as a group by origin; no function kind covers it.
